title: Janellis and the Eagle label's fate
summary: Eagle was a small New Orleans company near Little Woods owned by Janellis, who died before the records were released.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Company right out here in New Orleans.
Yeah. Right, right down, they call it, Little Woods down there, going out toward the lake.
Oh, yeah. Who was the guy? Who was the guy that owned it?
Uh, Janellis. Janellis. Janellis. Who was his name? Janellis, yeah. We never did do anything with the numbers. Poor fella died before we got a chance to do anything. Yeah.
I want to tell them about what happened to those records. Yeah. When the guy died and everything. Or why he died. What happened?

Oh, well, we did the recording, and before we could release the things, he died. I mean, I think that was good.
